message.content: {"note_claim": "NATO's Article 5 covers only armed attacks against members 'in Europe or North America', so an attack on a French base in the UAE would not be covered.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "an armed attack against one or more of them in Europe or North America shall be considered an attack against them all", "reason": "The treaty text directly contains the geographic limitation quoted in the note, and Article 6 likewise lists only territories and forces in Europe, North America, the Mediterranean and the North Atlantic north of the Tropic of Cancer, so the UAE is not included."}

parsed.note_claim: NATO's Article 5 covers only armed attacks against members 'in Europe or North America', so an attack on a French base in the UAE would not be covered.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: an armed attack against one or more of them in Europe or North America shall be considered an attack against them all
parsed.reason: The treaty text directly contains the geographic limitation quoted in the note, and Article 6 likewise lists only territories and forces in Europe, North America, the Mediterranean and the North Atlantic north of the Tropic of Cancer, so the UAE is not included.
